description: This file defines the 'ActivatorGenerator' class responsible for generating C# code for activator classes within the Orleans distributed application framework. It includes methods for creating class declarations, constructors, and create methods based on type descriptions, facilitating dynamic code generation for object activation.

classes.name: ActivatorGenerator
classes.description: A class responsible for generating C# source code for activator classes used in Orleans serialization and activation processes.

methods.name: GenerateActivator
methods.description: Generates a class declaration syntax for an activator based on the provided type description.

methods.name: GetSimpleClassName
methods.description: Returns a simple class name string for the activator class based on the type description.

methods.name: GenerateConstructor
methods.description: Creates a constructor syntax node for the activator class, initializing fields with constructor parameters.

methods.name: GenerateCreateMethod
methods.description: Creates a method syntax node that constructs an instance of the target type, using constructor arguments if available.
